learning_outcomes.text: Calculation of derivatives and limits of functions, determination of the stationary points and the use of this information to sketch curves.
Calculation of indefinite and definite integrals.
Find the Taylor series of simple functions and use them to approximate values of functions.
Perform basic operations with complex numbers.
Use of derivatives and integrals to solve problems arising in physical sciences and engineering.
Find the partials derivatives of functions of many variables and sketch the contour lines.

syllabus_topics: Elementary functions (exponential, trigonometric, hyperbolic, logarithmic, inverse)
Derivative of basic, inverse and implicit functions
Multiplication and division using the polar form
Change of variables in partial differentiation
Methods of integration (recognizing the presence of a function and its derivative, odd and even powers of sinx, cosx, change of variable, integration by parts, reduction formulae)
Surface area and volume of a solid by revolution
teaching_methods: Supportive learning through the active web site of the course in the learning platform (teleclass.uoc.gr)
bibliography: J. Hass, C. Heil, M. Weir, Thomas , Infinitesimal Calculus, PEK, 2018.
T. Rasias, Mathematics I, Tsotras Publishing,2017.
Wrede Robert C.,Spiegel Murray R. , Advanced Mathematics, Tziola Publishing, 2015.
degree: Materials Science and Engineering — Πτυχίο Τμήματος Επιστήμης και Μηχανικής Υλικών (first cycle, 240 ECTS, curriculum ΕΜΥ)
